verdict.rationale: MX documents sharing held data with an FDX open finance platform, an open-standard sharing route (mx-docs-11). It also offers monthly account statements as PDFs (mx-docs-10). Neither amounts to a documented export of all data that lets a customer leave. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, details on export formats and coverage, offboarding or data-deletion guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the FDX sharing works for leaving.
